segments.speaker: Maya Chen, Account Executive
segments.text:
Hi Jordan,

Attached is the order form for 90 user seats of the workflow package, annual term, start date August 15. It includes standard implementation and email support.

Total is $72,360 before tax, billed upfront with net 30 terms.

Maya

segments.speaker: Jordan Ellis, VP Operations
segments.text:
Maya,

Thanks. A few items from our side:

- We need the invoice dated after August 1
- Legal wants the renewal cap shown on the form, not just in email
- We may add 10 seats in Q4 if the Dallas team comes on

Also finance asked if there is any way to keep this under the $65k approval line.

Jordan

segments.speaker: Maya Chen, Account Executive
segments.text:
Yeah, so invoice date after August 1 is fine. I can set billing to generate on August 2 with payment due September 1.

Renewal cap will be listed as 5% in the subscription terms. Any Q4 seats would be prorated to the same end date, August 14, 2027.

I’ll check on the approval-line issue and come back today.

Maya

segments.speaker: Jordan Ellis, VP Operations
segments.text:
Appreciate it. If we can avoid the extra finance committee step, I can get the PO requested this week. Otherwise it moves to the August 12 agenda and we probably miss the go-live.

Jordan

segments.speaker: Maya Chen, Account Executive
segments.text:
Jordan,

Use the $64,800 I sent in the message thread for planning, and I’ll get the formal packet to line up before it goes out for signature.

Everything else stays the same: 90 seats, August 15 start, 12-month term, 5% renewal cap, standard onboarding.

Maya

segments.speaker: Jordan Ellis, VP Operations
segments.text:
Okay. Please send the updated order form when ready.

One more thing: our IT lead wants the kickoff the week of August 19, ideally Tuesday or Wednesday morning. We need SSO enabled before user invites go out.

Jordan

segments.speaker: Maya Chen, Account Executive
segments.text:
Updated form is attached.

I also added the SSO configuration line to the implementation notes. We have Tuesday, August 20 at 10:00 a.m. Central open for kickoff. The onboarding manager would do SSO first, then admin training, then bulk user upload.

Maya

segments.speaker: Jordan Ellis, VP Operations
segments.text:
Got it. I’m sending this to procurement now.

Please have the invoice reference PO-4187 once issued, and use accountspayable@northlakeops.com for billing. Contract signer is me unless legal changes it.

Jordan
